theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_rv_meanCurvature
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' U), W.weight = (ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n))⁻¹ • V.weight.map (fun x => R⁻¹ • (x - c)) → (∀ x, W.tangentProj x = V.tangentProj (c + R • x)) → ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → W.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun x => R • H (c + R • x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
